sloka: कुशस्य वचनम् श्रुत्वा चत्वारो लोक सत्तमाः ।निवेशम् चक्रिरे सर्वे पुराणाम् नृ वराः तदा ॥१-३२-५॥
transliteration: kuśasya vacanam śrutvā catvāro loka sattamāḥ ।niveśam cakrire sarve purāṇām nṛ varāḥ tadā ॥1-32-5॥

translations.english: "O my sons, govern with righteousness so that you will acquire immense merit'. Hearing the words of the rishi, the four sons who were the best among men and revered in the world constructed four cities as their abodes.
translations.hindi: र सुनियों के वचन सुनकर वे दोनों यशस्वी राजकुमार, छः दिनों . और रातों को बिना शयन किये निरन्तर उस तपोवन की रक्षा करते रहे
